subject: Out-of-cycle equity top-up request — R&D senior IC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Out-of-cycle equity top-up request — R&D senior IC

Hi all,

I want to request an out-of-cycle equity top-up for Rohan Mehta (Senior ML Engineer, R&D). He was promoted in March and has since received two competing offers; he has indicated that equity is the primary retention lever. Current situation: he is below our updated comp band midpoint for his level after the promotion, and peer benchmarking suggests we are ~15% behind market VRR for comparable hires in Q1–Q2.

Proposal summary (attached: comp_proposal_v1.pdf):
- One-time equity top-up: 0.08% additional RSU grant, cliff 1 year, vesting 4 years, effective 2026-06-01
- No base salary change; total cost projected at grant-value $36k on grant date
- Rationale: high impact IC, lead on latency-critical inference features, retention-critical through next product launch

Ask: can comp approve an exception to award an off-cycle equity top-up? If approved, we need HR and payroll to onboard the grant paperwork and schedule DocuSign. I’ve cc’d Laura, Marissa, Vivek, and Markus for review.

Quick context for approvers:
- Manager endorsement: I (Jordan) strongly support and will handle communication and 1:1 alignment with Rohan
- Business impact: Rohan leads a small cross-functional performance team tied to our Q3 deliverables
- Budget: I have provisional budget from my team’s discretionary pool; will accept any guidance on chargebacks

Next steps I’d like:
1) Laura — can you confirm HR policy gating items we should clear?
2) Marissa — comp modeling and whether this requires exec-level signoff beyond your threshold
3) Vivek — leadership signoff or escalation path if needed

Thanks — short turnaround requested (2–3 business days) if possible; Rohan shared timeline for counteroffers.

—
Jordan Blake
Director, R&D
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Out-of-cycle equity top-up request — R&D senior IC

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attached proposal. A few items we need before comp/legal/hr can sign off:
- Performance summary for the last 12 months (3 bullets max, manager-sourced)
- Current RSU schedule and any prior one-time awards (if any)
- Confirmation that this grant fits within your FY26 headcount/discretionary budget (number or dollar amount)
- Any manager notes on retention conversations (redacted) for audit trail

I’ve attached the comp_checklist.xlsx template — please fill out the highlighted fields and return. Once we have those, Marissa and I will run the comp model.

Also looping in Markus as I want an engineering rubric confirmation for impact level.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Jordan / Laura —

Thanks for the packet. I reviewed the manager notes and the business impact summary. I’m comfortable approving the request in principle up to 0.10% one-time RSU (your proposed 0.08% is within that band) as a retention exception. Please note:

- This approval is contingent on comp sign-off and legal clearance for the grant language.
- Finance needs the final dollar projection to confirm the chargeback to your cost center.

Marissa — please proceed to finalize the comp model and route for finance review. If comp flags any issues outside the standard policy, escalate back to me; otherwise, route the signed artifact to payroll for processing (PAYROLL-TICKET-2026-4872).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
